clue.text: Drunk stout initially from hose

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word stout

explanation.surface: A drinker takes the first swig of stout straight from a hosepipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Hose is an old and trade word for leg coverings worn snugly, the same garment as the answer.

clue.text: Correct a slide in principles

indicators.note: to correct something is to put it right, so these letters are rearranged into proper order

explanation.surface: A lecturer fixes a presentation slide about guiding principles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideals are standards or beliefs one lives by, a direct synonym of principles.

clue.text: A Greek, in secret, is henpecked

indicators.note: in places the A and the Greek abbreviation within the word for secret

parts.note: something hidden is secret

explanation.surface: A Greek man, privately, is dominated by his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Hag-ridden means tormented or harassed, as a man nagged by his wife is said to be henpecked.

clue.text: Writer sees road levels up continuously

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a road
to even up or evens things is to level them
on, as in 'went on and on', means without stopping

explanation.surface: An author watches a road being levelled bit by bit without a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Louis Stevenson is the Scottish author of Treasure Island, an example of a writer.

clue.text: Fabric ruined? Search me!

indicators.note: ruined letters are wrecked and put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asked whether their expensive fabric is ruined shrugs: search me!
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is a fine soft wool from Kashmir goats, a type of fabric.

clue.text: Honesty and love withheld by rotter

indicators.note: something withheld by a person is kept inside, so the rotter's word holds the other pieces

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible man, a rotter
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A scoundrel keeps back both honesty and love.
explanation.definitionFit: Candour is frankness and openness in speech, a synonym of honesty.

clue.text: A place to store decomposed flesh

indicators.note: decomposed means broken down, so the letters of flesh are taken apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: A grim instruction about where rotting meat should be kept.
explanation.definitionFit: A ledge fixed to a wall or in a cupboard is somewhere items are kept, so a storage spot.

clue.text: Intended partner to tuck into food

indicators.note: to tuck into something is to go inside it, so the partner sits within the food word

parts.note: meat is food in general, as in 'meat and drink'
in bridge North is South's partner, abbreviated N

explanation.surface: A partner meant to tuck into a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Meant is the past tense of mean, so it equals intended or planned.

clue.text: Downgrade king's eastern envoy

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king
a legate is a papal envoy or emissary

explanation.surface: An instruction to demote the king's ambassador from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to move to a lower rank or division, which is to downgrade.

clue.text: Colour of suit kept by writer

indicators.note: what is kept by something is held inside it, so the writer word encloses the suit word

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement
to suit is to agree with, as in 'that suits me'

explanation.surface: A suit's colour has been retained by an author.
explanation.definitionFit: Pea-green is a bright yellowish shade, so it names a colour.

clue.text: Give power to some given a blemish

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A recommendation to empower some people who have been given a flaw.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable is to make able or authorise, a direct synonym of give power.

clue.text: One tucking into rank fish

indicators.note: tucking into means going inside, so the numeral for one sits within the rank word

parts.note: a place is a position or rank, as in a race
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone digs into a smelly fish dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rank' looks like an adjective for the fish (smelly), but it is a noun meaning position.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaice is a European flatfish, so it is an example of a fish.

clue.text: Where player's not seen having bad leg

parts.note: food gone off has gone bad
a leg of a journey is one stage of it

explanation.surface: An actor or footballer stays out of view because of an injured leg.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor offstage is in the wings, out of the audience's view, so the player is unseen.

clue.text: Child finds tin has nothing in

indicators.note: has nothing in says the zero is placed inside the symbol for tin

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
nothing is zero, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A child discovers an empty tin can.
explanation.definitionFit: A son is a male child of his parents.

clue.text: Is East in time for puzzle?

indicators.note: in places the first two pieces inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
the Orient is the East

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether it is time for the Far East, a question of puzzlement.
explanation.definitionFit: To disorientate is to confuse or bewilder, which is what puzzle means as a verb.

clue.text: Development in Greece men vandalised

indicators.note: vandalised things are smashed up, so these letters are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: A news report on development in Greece damaged by rioting men.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergence is the process of coming into being or view, a sense of development.

clue.text: Trial marriage produces international confrontation

parts.note: a test is a trial
a match is a marriage, as in 'a good match'

explanation.surface: Living together before marrying leads to a cross-border row.
explanation.definitionFit: A Test match is a top-level cricket or rugby game between countries, an international contest.

clue.text: Net value is adjusted and that's final

indicators.note: adjusted letters are altered and put in a new order

explanation.surface: An accountant revises the net value and declares the matter closed.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventual describes what happens in the end, so it is ultimate or final.

clue.text: Don appears after ironing formal wear

indicators.note: after places the piece for don later than the ironing piece

parts.note: ironing clothes is evening them out, making them smooth
to don clothes is to dress in them

explanation.surface: A university don shows up after the ironing in black tie.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening dress is the formal attire worn to dinners and balls.

clue.text: One needs divinity for exasperation

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
RE, religious education, is the school subject once called divinity

explanation.surface: Someone needs religion to cope with frustration.
explanation.definitionFit: Ire is anger, the feeling exasperation produces.

clue.text: Research done initially during study in China

indicators.note: during puts the research letters inside the study word

parts.note: a den is a private study room
RES is a short form of research

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of done

explanation.surface: Research finished early during a period of study in China.
explanation.walkthrough: China seems to be the country but is porcelain; the capital letter hides that.
explanation.definitionFit: Dresden is a fine German porcelain, a type of china.

clue.text: Shrink back from touching snake

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
to snake is to twist or coil

explanation.surface: Someone flinches from contact with a serpent.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoil is to flinch or draw back, a synonym of shrink back.

clue.text: Drink tisane brewed by Lawrence

indicators.note: brewed tea leaves are stewed, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia, gives his initials

explanation.surface: Lawrence of Arabia makes himself a herbal tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Anisette is an aniseed-flavoured liqueur, a kind of drink.

clue.text: Lance accepts coppers in shop

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so the coin abbreviation goes inside the lance word

parts.note: to lance a boil is to slit it
P, pence, stands for coppers or small change

explanation.surface: A man named Lance takes small change in his shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Shop is slang for inform on, as 'split' also is in Britain; coppers are coins, not police.
explanation.definitionFit: Split is British slang for betraying someone to the authorities, which is to shop them.

clue.text: Pharaoh briefly has gold coach

parts.note: Tut is the familiar short name of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A short-reigning Egyptian king owns a golden carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a private teacher, which is what coach means here.

clue.text: Soldier — a man allowed a cocktail

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
M is the abbreviation for male, a man
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A soldier, a man permitted a cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: A gimlet is a cocktail of gin and lime juice.

clue.text: Shop's exit

definitions.meaning: a retail store, especially a factory one selling cheaply
a way out, as for water or steam

explanation.surface: The way out of a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Outlet means both a retail store and a vent or way out.

clue.text: Present and organise race

parts.note: to do a party is to organise it
a nation is a people or race

explanation.surface: A gift and a plan to organise a running race.
explanation.definitionFit: A donation is a gift, which is a present as a noun.

clue.text: Trainee tucking into quiche that's smoother

indicators.note: tucking into means getting inside, so the trainee word goes within the quiche word

parts.note: a flan is an open tart such as a quiche
a tiro is a novice or beginner

explanation.surface: A trainee chef eats a quiche that is extra smooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucking into' suggests eating, but it means going inside; smoother is a thing that smooths, not 'more smooth'.
explanation.definitionFit: A flatiron is an old-fashioned iron heated on a stove, a device for smoothing cloth.

clue.text: Discharge from old well

parts.note: ex means former or old
hale means healthy or well

explanation.surface: Water pumped from an ancient well.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhale is to breathe out, which is to discharge air from the lungs.
